candidate_system.system: Martinique, Lesser Antilles, tropical garden plant-pollinator networks
candidate_system.dataset_title: Floral offer and seasonality shape plant-pollinator networks in tropical gardens
candidate_system.published_sampling_scope: 10 garden sites sampled monthly over 12 months; floral offer and plant-insect interactions surveyed along the same 150 m site transects; insect interactions monitored for 60 min per site per month

source_only_admission_rule: Admit for a later full-v9 reconstruction gate only if author-deposited bytes expose repeated site/time plant-insect interaction records and an independently measured plant/floral-offer table at compatible site/time scale. Sampling exposure must be documented in source metadata or source fields. Do not inspect any v9 target or predictive output.
primary_biological_scope: Use insect interactions only for the prospective v9 gate because source metadata states a fixed 60 min per site per month insect protocol. Bird interactions are binary per bi-period and are outside this gate.
hard_boundaries: Source admission is not target calculation.
Do not choose monthly versus source-defined bi-period networks based on interaction outcomes; freeze this later from source field structure.
Do not infer floral opportunity from plants that received visits; require an independently recorded floral-offer source.
Do not calculate pair-support fraction, turnover, Shannon diversity, plant/pollinator support statistics, empirical ranges, or v9 predictive fit.
Menorca, Giannutri and Cabrera are consumed failures; Thousand Island Lake is pair-support-only and cannot confirm full v9.
